### The Eminence in Shadow: Master of Garden (`com.crunchyroll.eminenceinshadowrpg`)

- **Player Defense**: God Mode (Invincible Allies), Always Full HP, Defense Multiplier (x1 - x50)
- **Attack & OHK**: One-Hit Kill (Instant Enemy Kill), Damage Multiplier (x1 - x50)
- **Enemy Debuffs**: Enemy 0 Defense, Enemy Weak Attack (1 DMG), Freeze Enemy SP, Instant Wipe All Enemies
- **Speed & SP**: Infinite SP / Instant Ultimate, Battle Speed Multiplier (x1 - x5), Unlock 60/120 FPS
- **Auto-Update & Device Token**: Built-in Cloud Offset Sync & 1-User Device Lock
